package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
)

// scenario for pagination_validation_missing_shared_bound_helper: API modules that hand-roll page and page-size bounds in many handlers instead of a shared contract.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func GetItemsHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	page, err := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("page"))
	if err != nil || page <= 0 {
		http.Error(w, "invalid page", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	limit, err := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("limit"))
	if err != nil || limit <= 0 || limit > 100 {
		http.Error(w, "invalid limit", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	offset := (page - 1) * limit
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "items: page=%d, limit=%d, offset=%d", page, limit, offset)
}
